The '''ECM-598''' was an all-purpose emergency medical kit developed by the [[Chiewab Amalgamated Pharmaceuticals Company]]. The backpack was quite commonly used by [[Medic/Legends|Medics]].

==Characteristics==
The backpack contained a wide array of medical devices and medicines, including:
*Various medicines, such as anesthetics, anti-venom, anti-radiation, and blood pressure regulators contained within a medicine dispenser
*Diagnostic scanner for determining vital signs and recommended treatment
*Emergency procedure database, complete with tutorial for non-medics
*Laser scalpel, universal plasma fluid sacks, pressurized sterilization bandages and heat-insulating blanket
*Filtration mask, pressurized cuffs and portable repulsor-stretcher with 150 kilogram weight limit
